entries.zh: 原告；讼案中兴讼控告之一方
entries.en: plaintiff, prosecuting party in a lawsuit

entries.zh: 当行；承当差役、应承义务（当值应差）
entries.en: to undertake or answer an obligation; to serve one's turn of duty
entries.notes: M栏音写与“當行”对音不合（或系异读或误写），义据L“acudir a la obligación”与H“當行”（当差应役）而定。

entries.en: seal; to seal, stamp; to print, imprint

entries.zh: 应卯；点卯应差，如兵士应点名到班（支应差事）
entries.en: to answer the muster or roll call, to report for duty (as a soldier)

entries.zh: 彼处、那儿（原件作“许处”，指示词“那”之处所用法）
entries.notes: L“Aculla”疑为指示词aquella（“那”）之读形，与H“許處”（彼处）相合；M栏附注inay.未能解读。

entries.en: to denounce, to inform against, to accuse

entries.zh: 首状；递状首告（以状纸告发）
entries.en: to accuse by formal petition; to file a written denunciation

entries.zh: 催状；催促究办之控状（诉状一类）
entries.notes: H“催状”（催＝催促）与L acusación语义未尽吻合，或指催究之状，据M、R对音催字并存此义，待校。

entries.zh: 被告；被控告之人（涉讼与被告发者）
entries.en: defendant; the accused (in suit and complaint)
to present or submit in writing; to accuse by written petition

entries.zh: 呈状；呈递之状纸（书面控状）
研（甘）蔗；榨蔗制糖，制糖者／糖磨（糖寮）
entries.en: sugar mill or sugar-maker; one who grinds sugarcane for sugar
entries.notes: H第三字转写“柑”与“甘”同音，义当为甘蔗之甘；açucarero据马尼拉糖业语境解作榨蔗制糖之人或磨。
